def transform(grid):
    """Stamp every occurrence of the rare colored motif onto matching zero cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v != 0:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    if not counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    motif_colors = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    if not motif_colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    motif = min(motif_colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == motif]
    minr, maxr = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar in range(h - (maxr - minr + 1) + 1):
        for ac in range(w - (maxc - minc + 1) + 1):
            if all(grid[ar + dr][ac + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[ar + dr][ac + dc] = motif
    return out
PY
